insight: Raised a $40M Series B led by Battery Ventures in July 2025; customers include Cursor, Perplexity, Airwallex, and Together AI.
name: Unify
tagline: AI go-to-market platform that turns intent signals into automated, personalized outreach.
description: Unify is an AI-native go-to-market platform that helps sales and growth teams build pipeline by combining 25+ intent signals, B2B contact data, and AI agents that research accounts and write personalized outreach. It orchestrates multichannel sequences across email and LinkedIn with built-in deliverability infrastructure, so reps reach high-intent prospects at the right moment. It's aimed at revenue teams that want prospecting, enrichment, and engagement in one system rather than a stack of point tools.
edge: Pairs 25+ intent signals with AI research agents and automated multichannel sequences, so one platform both finds warm accounts and runs the outreach.
pros: Combines intent data, enrichment, and outreach
AI agents research and personalize at scale
Backed by OpenAI Startup Fund and Thrive

references.title: Unify Raises $40M Series B to Transform Go-To-Market with AI
